preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of elements in the sequence is between 1 and 10^4 for each test case.
Each element in the sequence B is between 1 and its index for each valid i.

postconditions.description: The output should be either 'YES' if it is possible to obtain the sequence A = B or 'NO' if it is impossible.
